summary_en: Seiwa Electric approved the acquisition of up to 80,000 shares (0.62% of issued shares excluding treasury stock) at a fixed price of 712 yen per share via ToSTNeT-3 on November 13, 2026, for a total outlay not exceeding 56.96 million yen.
title_en: Notice Regarding Acquisition of Treasury Shares and Purchase of Treasury Shares via Off-Auction Trading (ToSTNeT-3)
translation_en_brief:
On November 12, 2026, Seiwa Electric's board of directors authorized the acquisition of treasury shares in a single execution block. The company will purchase up to 80,000 shares (0.62% of the 12,883,997 issued shares excluding treasury stock) at a fixed price of 712 yen per share—the closing price on the day of the board decision—through ToSTNeT-3 off-auction trading on November 13, 2026. The total acquisition amount will not exceed 56.96 million yen.

The company will place a buy order during the designated ToSTNeT-3 trading session (8:45 AM on November 13), valid only for that time window. The purchase will be matched against sell orders from shareholders, including existing shareholders who have informed the company of their intention to sell their holdings. The company stated the acquisition is intended to execute flexible capital policy in response to changing business conditions. Results will be disclosed after the close of trading on November 13, 2026.
